profile_text.body:
Meta is a public company founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, CA. Its llama.com site presents the company primarily as a platform for AI developers, describing tools and models available through the Meta Model API, which is described as compatible with the OpenAI SDK. The site highlights several AI products: Muse Spark, described as a coding-optimized model that writes, reviews, and ships code with lower latency and fewer steps; Muse Code, described as a coding agent built to run Muse Spark; and Muse Glimmer, described as a 30-billion-parameter open model optimized for local agent workflows and small enough to run on a Mac or PC with a single consumer GPU. The site also describes multi-agent workflow support and a search grounding feature that gives models live web access.

The held facts list one tracked AI product, Llama, described as an open-weight model family often used in self-hosted deployments. Meta's most recently reported annual revenue was $200,966,000,000, per a 10-K filing. The company trades publicly under the ticker META with CIK 0001326801.

Meta faces three tracked lawsuits: Neural AI, LLC v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the Western District of Texas; Chicken Soup for the Soul, LLC v. Meta Platforms Inc. in the Northern District of California; and Kadrey v. Meta Platforms, Inc., also in the Northern District of California. Several third-party MCP servers in the registry connect to Meta's advertising infrastructure, covering campaign management, creative automation, and performance analysis across Facebook and Instagram.
